## `r paste0(fig_name_to_use," : ",long_name_to_use)` {.tabset}

TISSUE TRIMMED = subclusters/clusters were removed if < 3 cells in at least 7/15 LN or 11/22 PBMC samples


```{r deg_hms, results='asis', fig.height=12, fig.width=6}

### NOTE: `cluster` (renamed to `source` here) is already the final name
### (Step 4 above) -- add broad_category directly from finalnames_df's
### underscore-style columns instead of re-joining dot-style columns.
### source_final == source is retained only so downstream references to
### `source_final` in this chunk and its callers don't need to change.
df_for_heatmap_prep <- curr_degs_df_trim %>% 
  dplyr::rename(source=cluster,ligand=gene,source_tiss = Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ligand %in% degs_to_plot &
                  contrast %in% contrasts_to_use & 
                  source_tiss %in% tiss_to_use_deg) %>%
  ### add broad category (source is already the final name)
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                     dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(source = final_name_051926, source_broad = broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "source") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source_final = source) %>%
  ### get average of avg_log2FC across cell subsets
  dplyr::group_by(!!!rlang::syms(unique(c(names_column_to_use,"contrast","source_tiss","source_broad","ligand")))) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_avg_log2FC = mean(meanAcrossAnimals_log2FC)) %>% ##ignores animals that are not sig changing so Ave across sig animals
  ungroup() %>%
    ## trim & sort to only celltypes want
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = !!rlang::sym(names_column_to_use)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(tissue = source_tiss, broad = source_broad) %>%
  dplyr::filter(celltype %in% ordered_celltypes_for_plot) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(celltype = factor(celltype, ordered_celltypes_for_plot),
                ligand = factor(ligand, degs_to_plot),
                contrast = factor(contrast, contrasts_to_use),
                tissue = factor(tissue,c("PBMC","LN")),
                mean_avg_log2FC = round(mean_avg_log2FC,1)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(tissue,  contrast, ligand, broad, celltype)


####### set celltype timpoint order
  ct_time_order <- c()
  for(curr_ct in ordered_celltypes_for_plot){
    ct_time_order <- c(ct_time_order,paste0(curr_ct,"_",contrasts_to_use))
  }
  ctt_time_order <- c()
  for(curr_tiss in tiss_to_use_deg){
    ctt_time_order <- c(ctt_time_order, paste0(ct_time_order,"_",curr_tiss))
  }
  
  


###### for rows = cluster, columns = gene
if(row_variable == "cluster"){
  
  
  
  df_for_heatmap <- df_for_heatmap_prep %>%
          ### combine celltype+time+tiss
    dplyr::mutate(celltype_time_tiss = paste0(as.character(celltype),"_",as.character(contrast), "_", as.character(tissue)),
                  celltype_time_tiss = factor(celltype_time_tiss,unique(celltype_time_tiss))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-celltype, -contrast, -tissue) %>%
  ## make wide
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "ligand", values_from = "mean_avg_log2FC") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype_time_tiss = factor(celltype_time_tiss, ctt_time_order)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(celltype_time_tiss) %>%
      column_to_rownames("celltype_time_tiss")  %>%
  dplyr::relocate(!!!rlang::syms(intersect(degs_to_plot,colnames(.))))
  
  annotation_names <- rownames(df_for_heatmap)
  
  
## ── Drop-in replacement for the row_variable == "gene" branch of deg_hms ──
## (everything else in deg_hms stays the same -- only this else{} block changes)

}else{
  ###### for rows = genes, columns = clusters

  ## 1. figure out which clusters actually have >=1 DEG (any gene, any
  ##    contrast/tissue in scope) -- these are the only clusters we keep.
  ##    Clusters with zero DEGs across BOTH timepoints are dropped entirely,
  ##    exactly as before (this set is already implicit in df_for_heatmap_prep,
  ##    we just need it explicitly to drive the completion step below).
  clusters_with_any_deg <- df_for_heatmap_prep %>%
    dplyr::distinct(celltype, broad, tissue) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype = as.character(celltype),
                  tissue = as.character(tissue))

  ## 2. build the FULL set of celltype_time_tiss columns that SHOULD exist
  ##    for each (celltype, tissue) that has at least one DEG -- i.e. every
  ##    contrast in contrasts_to_use, even ones with zero DEGs for that
  ##    cluster. This is what lets a cluster that's only sig at DAY8 still
  ##    get a (blank) DAY2 column.
  full_col_skeleton <- clusters_with_any_deg %>%
    tidyr::crossing(contrast = contrasts_to_use) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      celltype = factor(celltype, ordered_celltypes_for_plot),
      broad = factor(broad, names(broad_colors_vec)),
      contrast = factor(contrast, contrasts_to_use),
      tissue   = factor(tissue, tiss_to_use_deg),
      celltype_time_tiss = paste0(as.character(celltype),"_",as.character(contrast),"_",as.character(tissue))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(celltype)) %>%            # drop any tissue/celltype combo not in requested order
    dplyr::arrange(celltype, tissue) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(celltype_time_tiss, broad, celltype, tissue, contrast)

  ## 3. pivot the actual DEG values wide (same as before)
  df_for_heatmap_wide <- df_for_heatmap_prep %>%
    dplyr::mutate(celltype_time_tiss = paste0(as.character(celltype),"_",as.character(contrast), "_", as.character(tissue)),
                  celltype_time_tiss = factor(celltype_time_tiss,unique(celltype_time_tiss))) %>%
    dplyr::select(ligand, celltype_time_tiss, mean_avg_log2FC) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "celltype_time_tiss", values_from = "mean_avg_log2FC")

  ## 4. add any missing columns (cluster+contrast combos with zero DEGs for
  ##    that specific timepoint, but >=1 DEG at the OTHER timepoint) as all-NA
  missing_cols <- setdiff(full_col_skeleton$celltype_time_tiss, colnames(df_for_heatmap_wide))
  for (mc in missing_cols) {
    df_for_heatmap_wide[[mc]] <- NA_real_
  }

  # ## 5. final column order: tissue -> celltype -> contrast, restricted to
  # ##    kept clusters only (this replaces ctt_time_order for this branch)
  # ctt_time_order_filled <- full_col_skeleton %>%
  #   dplyr::arrange(tissue, celltype, contrast) %>%
  #   dplyr::pull(celltype_time_tiss) %>%
  #   unique()
  
   ## 5. final column order: celltype -> tissue -> contrast, restricted to
  ##    kept clusters only (this replaces ctt_time_order for this branch)
  # ctt_time_order_filled <- full_col_skeleton %>%
  #   dplyr::arrange(celltype, tissue, contrast) %>%
  #   dplyr::pull(celltype_time_tiss) %>%
  #   unique()
  
  
     ## 5. final column order: contrast -> celltype -> tissue, restricted to
  ##    kept clusters only (this replaces ctt_time_order for this branch)
  ctt_time_order_filled <- full_col_skeleton %>%
    dplyr::arrange(contrast, broad, tissue, celltype) %>%
    dplyr::pull(celltype_time_tiss) %>%
    unique()
  
  

  df_for_heatmap <- df_for_heatmap_wide %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ligand = factor(ligand, degs_to_plot)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(ligand) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("ligand") %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(intersect(ctt_time_order_filled, colnames(.))))

  annotation_names <- colnames(df_for_heatmap)
}
  

  
  if(annotate_genes){

    ###### build per-gene "dir" classification: which contrast(s) each gene is a DEG in
    gene_dir_df <- curr_degs_df_trim %>%
      dplyr::rename(source=cluster,ligand=gene,source_tiss = Tissue) %>%
      dplyr::filter(ligand %in% rownames(df_for_heatmap) &
                      contrast %in% contrasts_to_use &
                      source_tiss %in% tiss_to_use_deg) %>%
      dplyr::select(ligand,contrast) %>%
      unique() %>%
      dplyr::group_by(ligand) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(contrasts_present = list(sort(unique(as.character(contrast)))), .groups="drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dir = dplyr::case_when(
        purrr::map_lgl(contrasts_present, ~ setequal(.x, contrasts_to_use)) ~ "both",
        purrr::map_lgl(contrasts_present, ~ setequal(.x, contrasts_to_use[1])) ~ paste0(contrasts_to_use[1]," only"),
        purrr::map_lgl(contrasts_present, ~ setequal(.x, contrasts_to_use[2])) ~ paste0(contrasts_to_use[2]," only"),
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      dplyr::select(ligand,dir) %>%
      dplyr::rename(gene = ligand)

    gene_annotation_to_use <- gene_annotation_to_use_prep %>%
      dplyr::filter(gene %in% rownames(df_for_heatmap)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(gene_dir_df, by = "gene") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(type = factor(type, names(gene_annotation_colors_to_use)),
                    gene = factor(gene, unique(gene)), ### keep her ordering
                    dir = factor(dir, dir_levels_to_use)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(type, #dir, 
                     gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(type, dir, gene) %>%
      dplyr::rename(rowname = gene) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("rowname")

    ##### re-sort df_for_heatmap rows to match annotation order (now that gene_annotation_to_use exists)
    df_for_heatmap <- df_for_heatmap[rownames(gene_annotation_to_use),]

    ##### add IFN type + dir colors to annotation_colors
    annotation_colors[["type"]] <- gene_annotation_colors_to_use
    annotation_colors[["dir"]] <- dir_annotation_colors_to_use

  }
  

if(grepl("broad",names_column_to_use)){
annotation_to_use <- data.frame("rowname"=annotation_names) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(broad=factor(str_before_last(str_before_last(rowname,"_"),"_"),ordered_celltypes_for_plot),
                contrast=factor(str_after_last(str_before_last(rowname,"_"),"_"), contrasts_to_use),
                tissue = factor(str_after_last(rowname,"_"),tiss_to_use_deg)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(tissue, contrast, broad) %>%
  column_to_rownames()

title_to_use <- "mean avg_log2FC (across animals) across celltypes"

 
  
  annotation_colors[["broad"]] <- broad_colors_vec
}else{
  annotation_to_use <- data.frame("rowname"=annotation_names) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(contrast =factor(str_after_last(str_before_last(rowname,"_"),"_"), contrasts_to_use),
                tissue = factor(str_after_last(rowname,"_"),tiss_to_use_deg),
                      cluster = str_before_last(str_before_last(rowname,"_"),"_")
                  
                ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(colors_df_final %>%
                       dplyr::select(source_broad,cluster_final) %>%
                       dplyr::rename(cluster=cluster_final,broad=source_broad),
                     
                     by = "cluster") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, ordered_celltypes_for_plot),
                      broad = factor(broad, names(broad_colors_vec))) %>%

    dplyr::relocate(cluster,broad) %>%

  column_to_rownames()
  
  
  title_to_use <- "avg_log2FC (across animals)"

  
}




labSize <- 10

##### white text for dark fill, black for light fill
midpoint <- mean(range(breakscale))  # = (1 + 7) / 2 = 4
```

```{r setDEGs_Fig4c_MIFgenes}
fig_name_to_use <- "Fig4cBOT"
long_name_to_use <- "MIF genes"
tiss_to_use_deg <- c("PBMC","LN")
names_column_to_use <- "source_final"
contrasts_to_use <- c("DAY2vsPRE","DAY8vsPRE")

## order every LN cluster by broad category so rows group sensibly even
## though we're plotting source_final (individual clusters)
ordered_celltypes_for_plot <- c(
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Myeloid")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Bcell")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "CD4")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "CD8")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "otherT")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "NK")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "GATA3")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Neutrophil")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Platelet")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Erythro")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Prog")]
)

###### rows = gene, columns = cluster (every individual cluster, not broad cat)
row_variable <- "gene"

degs_to_plot <- c("MIF","CD74","CXCR4","CD44"#,
                  # "MAMU-A","MAMU-E","MAMU-F",
                  # "MAMU-DRA","MAMU-DRB1","MAMU-DMB","MAMU-DOA","MAMU-DOB",
                  #  "CTSS","LGMN"
                  )

## no significance/magnitude filter -- deg_hms already leaves a cell NA
## (white) whenever a gene/cluster/contrast combo isn't in curr_degs_df_trim
## (i.e. not called significant for that cluster), so all 9 genes are shown
## everywhere, with NA where not DEG/not tested.

annotate_genes <- FALSE

###### toggle to print/hide numbers in heatmap cells
print_numbers_hm <- TRUE

#### most common DEGs in LN, for reference/QC (not used for filtering)
numDEGs <- curr_degs_df_trim %>%
  dplyr::rename(source=cluster,ligand=gene,source_tiss = Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast %in% contrasts_to_use &
                  source_tiss %in% tiss_to_use_deg) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                     dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(source = final_name_051926, source_broad = broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "source") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source_final = source) %>%
  dplyr::select(source_final,ligand) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ligand) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(numCelltypes = n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(numCelltypes))

### should match names_column_to_use levels (source_final here)
colors_df_final <- colors_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_final = cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                     dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(cluster = final_name_051926, source_broad = broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "cluster") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cluster_final))

annotation_colors <- list(
  "cluster"=setNames(colors_df_final$color,
                      colors_df_final$cluster_final),
  "broad"=broad_colors_vec,
  "contrast"=c("DAY2vsPRE"="#5A5399",
               "DAY8vsPRE"="#817ACD",
               "DAY8vsDAY2"="#C1BBFF"),
  "tissue"=c("PBMC"="black","LN"="grey")
)

###### for neg/positive log2FC scale -- these are mostly up with antigen
###### presentation genes, but keep symmetric scale for honesty
#mycols <- colorRampPalette(c("black","turquoise4","white","lightgoldenrod1","darkorange3"))(1000)
mycols <- colorRampPalette(c("black","turquoise4","lightgoldenrod1","darkorange3","darkred"))(1000)
scale_low <- -4
scale_high <- 4

breakscale <- c(scale_low, seq(0.9*scale_low, 0.9*scale_high, length.out=length(mycols)-1), 1*scale_high)
```

```{r cellchatPrep_part1b, eval = FALSE}
##### uses saved cellchat obj from the first half of ccrvb47_batch1123_CellChatPrep_DiffComp_rpca_withSubs_PBMC_DAY2vsPRE.sh
study_name_to_use <- "batch123_38samps_rpca_tiss_trimmed"
res_to_use <- "respt4_rpca_ClustersWithSubs"
species <- "human" ## human (or could be mouse)

############################################################
# packages & functions
############################################################
# package list
list.of.packages=c(
  "tidyverse","strex","Seurat"#"reticulate"
  )


#install as needed
new.packages <- list.of.packages[!(list.of.packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(new.packages)) BiocManager::install(new.packages)
### needs to be installed directly from github
devtools::install_github("jinworks/CellChat")
devtools::install_github('immunogenomics/presto')

# load packages
invisible(lapply(list.of.packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
library(CellChat)
library(presto)
#reticulate::py_install(packages = 'umap-learn')
#library(umap-learn)

#study_name_to_use <- "LN"
params <- list(
  "study_name" = study_name_to_use
)

#### for local
input_dir <- "~/Documents/BarbaraFelber/ccrvb47_LIONscRNAseq/RData_batches1to5" ### local



###################### process PBMC #################
curr_tissue <- "PBMC"
##### read the cellchat objects
cellchat_PRE <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_tissue,"_",res_to_use,"_diffComp_DAY2vsPRE_PRE_cellchat.rds")))
cellchat_POST <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_tissue,"_",res_to_use,"_diffComp_DAY2vsPRE_DAY2_cellchat.rds")))
cellchat_DAY8 <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_tissue,"_",res_to_use,"_diffComp_DAY8vsPRE_DAY8_cellchat.rds")))


# Compute the communication probability and infer cellular communication network
##### this takes a while (~15 min) for each
ptm = Sys.time()

###### first for pre
cellchat_PRE <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_PRE, type = "triMean") # started at 10:41, took ~30 min
#### not explicitly filtering communication, default is 10
# Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
cellchat_PRE <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_PRE)
#Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
cellchat_PRE <- aggregateNet(cellchat_PRE)
# Compute the network centrality scores
cellchat_PRE <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat_PRE, slot.name = "netP")


###### now for post
cellchat_POST <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_POST, type = "triMean") # started at 11:14am, took ~15 min
#### not explicitly filtering communication, default is 10
# Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
cellchat_POST <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_POST)
#Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
cellchat_POST <- aggregateNet(cellchat_POST)
# Compute the network centrality scores
cellchat_POST <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat_POST, slot.name = "netP")


###### now for DAY8
cellchat_DAY8 <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_DAY8, type = "triMean") # started at 12pm, took ~30min
#### not explicitly filtering communication, default is 10
# Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
cellchat_DAY8 <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_DAY8)
#Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
cellchat_DAY8 <- aggregateNet(cellchat_DAY8)
# Compute the network centrality scores
cellchat_DAY8 <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat_DAY8, slot.name = "netP")

group.new_PBMC = union(union(levels(cellchat_PRE@idents), levels(cellchat_POST@idents)),levels(cellchat_DAY8@idents))


                       
                       
                       
                       
###################### process LN #################
curr_tissue <- "LN"
##### read the cellchat objects
LN_cellchat_PRE <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_tissue,"_",res_to_use,"_diffComp_DAY2vsPRE_PRE_cellchat.rds")))
LN_cellchat_POST <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_tissue,"_",res_to_use,"_diffComp_DAY2vsPRE_DAY2_cellchat.rds")))
LN_cellchat_DAY8 <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_",curr_tissue,"_",res_to_use,"_diffComp_DAY8vsPRE_DAY8_cellchat.rds")))


# Compute the communication probability and infer cellular communication network
##### this takes a while (~15 min) for each
ptm = Sys.time()

###### first for pre
LN_cellchat_PRE <- computeCommunProb(LN_cellchat_PRE, type = "triMean") # started at 12:33pm, took ~ 20min
#### not explicitly filtering communication, default is 10
# Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
LN_cellchat_PRE <- computeCommunProbPathway(LN_cellchat_PRE)
#Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
LN_cellchat_PRE <- aggregateNet(LN_cellchat_PRE)
# Compute the network centrality scores
LN_cellchat_PRE <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(LN_cellchat_PRE, slot.name = "netP")


###### now for post
LN_cellchat_POST <- computeCommunProb(LN_cellchat_POST, type = "triMean") # started at 1:12pm, took ~ 20min
#### not explicitly filtering communication, default is 10
# Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
LN_cellchat_POST <- computeCommunProbPathway(LN_cellchat_POST)
#Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
LN_cellchat_POST <- aggregateNet(LN_cellchat_POST)
# Compute the network centrality scores
LN_cellchat_POST <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(LN_cellchat_POST, slot.name = "netP")


###### now for DAY8
LN_cellchat_DAY8 <- computeCommunProb(LN_cellchat_DAY8, type = "triMean") # started at 1:48pm, took ~10 min
#### not explicitly filtering communication, default is 10
# Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
LN_cellchat_DAY8 <- computeCommunProbPathway(LN_cellchat_DAY8)
#Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
LN_cellchat_DAY8 <- aggregateNet(LN_cellchat_DAY8)
# Compute the network centrality scores
LN_cellchat_DAY8 <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(LN_cellchat_DAY8, slot.name = "netP")

group.new_LN = union(union(levels(LN_cellchat_PRE@idents), levels(LN_cellchat_POST@idents)),levels(LN_cellchat_DAY8@idents))



########### collect all the clusters across both tissues
###### these are now different so the lifting is critical
group.new <- union(group.new_LN, group.new_PBMC)                      
                  
                       
                       
group.new_LN   
group.new_PBMC
group.new                       
                       
                       
                       
          
                       
                       

##### now prepare to merge the 2 cellchat objects for each contrast https://htmlpreview.github.io/?https://github.com/jinworks/CellChat/blob/master/tutorial/Comparison_analysis_of_multiple_datasets.html
```

```{r summaryCellchat, results='asis', fig.width=18, fig.height=10}
df_long_for_plot <- summtab_prep %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!broad_interaction, names_to = "contrast", values_to = "pathways") %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(pathways, sep = "<br>")


####### to plot all neworks
# for(curr_contrast in sort(unique(df_long_for_plot$contrast))){
#

#   cat("###### ",paste0(curr_contrast," {.tabset}"),"\n")
#   cat('\n')

  
#### for just D8vsPRE down
for(curr_contrast in c("PBMCPBMCdnDAY8vsPRE","LNLNdnDAY8vsPRE")){

cat("### ",paste0(curr_contrast," {.tabset}"),"\n")
cat('\n')



if(curr_contrast == "LNLNupDAY8vsPRE"){
  size_gene <- 5
  size_path <- 6
}else{
    size_gene <- 7
  size_path <- 8
}

# 1. Filter to contrast, drop NA pathways
df_sub <- df_long_for_plot %>%
  filter(contrast == curr_contrast, !is.na(pathways)) %>% ##### for all pathways at this contrast
  filter(grepl("TGFb",pathways)) %>% ##### for only TGFb
  mutate(
    source = str_extract(broad_interaction, "^[^\\s]+(?=\\s->)"),
    target = str_extract(broad_interaction, "(?<=>\\s).+$")
  )

# 2. Expand <br>-concatenated pathways → one row per pathway
edges <- df_sub %>%
  mutate(pathway = str_split(pathways, "<br>")) %>%
  unnest(pathway) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_name = str_extract(pathway, "^[^:]+"),
    ligand       = str_extract(pathway, "(?<=:\\s).+(?=\\s-)"),
    receptor     = str_extract(pathway, "(?<=-\\s).+$")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ligand), !is.na(receptor)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = paste0(source, "\n", ligand),
    to   = paste0(target, "\n", receptor)
  )

# 3. Node table with cell_type and role for coloring/shape
nodes <- tibble(name = unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_type = str_extract(name, "^[^\n]+"),
    role = case_when(
      name %in% edges$from & name %in% edges$to ~ "Both",
      name %in% edges$from                      ~ "Ligand",
      name %in% edges$to                        ~ "Receptor",
      TRUE                                       ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# 4. Build igraph object
g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d        = edges %>% select(from, to, pathway_name, source),
  vertices = nodes,
  directed = TRUE
)

# 5. Extract FR layout
set.seed(42)
layout_fr <- create_layout(g, layout = "fr")

# 5b. Compute per-node nudge direction away from its local edge centroid
node_coords <- layout_fr %>% select(name, x, y)

edge_midpoints <- edges %>%
  select(from, to) %>%
  left_join(node_coords, by = c("from" = "name")) %>% rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) %>%
  left_join(node_coords, by = c("to"   = "name")) %>% rename(x_to   = x, y_to   = y) %>%
  mutate(x_mid = (x_from + x_to) / 2,
         y_mid = (y_from + y_to) / 2)

node_edge_centroid <- bind_rows(
  edge_midpoints %>% select(node = from, x_mid, y_mid),
  edge_midpoints %>% select(node = to,   x_mid, y_mid)
) %>%
  group_by(node) %>%
  summarise(cx = mean(x_mid, na.rm = TRUE), cy = mean(y_mid, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

nudge_amount <- 0.5

label_df <- node_coords %>%
  left_join(node_edge_centroid, by = c("name" = "node")) %>%
  mutate(
    dx      = x - cx,
    dy      = y - cy,
    dist    = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2),
    nudge_x = ifelse(dist > 0, dx / dist * nudge_amount, 0),
    nudge_y = ifelse(dist > 0, dy / dist * nudge_amount, 0),
    label   = str_extract(name, "(?<=\n).+")
  ) %>%
  select(x, y, nudge_x, nudge_y, label) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# 5c. Self-loop edges for manual drawing
self_loops <- edges %>%
  filter(from == to) %>%
  select(from, source) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(node_coords, by = c("from" = "name"))

# 6. Pathway label positions + ellipse sizes
nudge_up <- 1.5

pathway_labels <- edges %>%
  select(from, to, pathway_name) %>%
  left_join(node_coords, by = c("from" = "name")) %>%
  rename(x_from = x, y_from = y) %>%
  left_join(node_coords, by = c("to" = "name")) %>%
  rename(x_to = x, y_to = y) %>%
  mutate(x_mid = (x_from + x_to) / 2,
         y_mid = (y_from + y_to) / 2) %>%
  group_by(pathway_name) %>%
  summarise(
    x       = mean(x_mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    y       = mean(y_mid, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nodes = n_distinct(c(from, to)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_y   = y + nudge_up,
    ellipse_a = 0.5 + n_nodes * 0.15,
    ellipse_b = 0.3 + n_nodes * 0.08
  )

# 7. Plot
p <- ggraph(layout_fr) +
  geom_ellipse(
    data        = pathway_labels,
    aes(x0 = x, y0 = y, a = ellipse_a, b = ellipse_b, angle = 0),
    fill        = "grey92",
    color       = "grey80",
    linewidth   = 0.3,
    alpha       = 0.7,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(color = source),
    arrow       = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    end_cap     = circle(4, "mm"),
    start_cap   = circle(4, "mm"),
    linewidth   = 1.5,
    linejoin    = "mitre",
    linemitre   = 10
  ) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(
    values = broad_colors_vec,
    name   = "Source"
  ) +
  geom_curve(
    data        = self_loops,
    aes(x = x - 0.2, y = y, xend = x + 0.2, yend = y, color = source),
    curvature   = -1.5,
    arrow       = arrow(length = unit(4, "mm"), type = "open"),
    linewidth   = 1.5,
    lineend     = "butt",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = broad_colors_vec,
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  geom_node_point(
    aes(fill = cell_type, shape = role),
    size   = 7,
    color  = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data        = label_df,
    aes(x = x + nudge_x, y = y + nudge_y, label = label),
    size        = size_gene,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data          = pathway_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = label_y, label = pathway_name),
    size          = size_path,
    label.size    = 0.2,
    fill          = "white",
    alpha         = 0.75,
    max.overlaps  = 20,
    box.padding   = 0.1,
    force         = 0.3,
    segment.color = NA,
    inherit.aes   = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values   = broad_colors_vec,
    name     = "Cell type",
    na.value = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(Ligand = 21, Receptor = 24, Both = 23),
    name   = "Role"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 5, color = "black", stroke = 0.8)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey70", size = 5, color = "black", stroke = 0.8))
  ) +
  labs(title = paste("Cell-cell interactions:", curr_contrast)) +
  theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

plot(p)

cat("\n")
cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!

}
```

```{r degpair_tables, results='asis'}
### NOTE: colors_df$cluster and curr_degs_df_trim$cluster are already final
### names (Steps 3/4 above), so cluster_final == cluster and
### source_final/target_final == source/target here. All three joins below
### now add only broad_category from finalnames_df's underscore-style columns,
### rather than re-deriving already-correct final names via dot-style columns.
colors_df_final <- colors_df %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_final = cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                         dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                         dplyr::rename(cluster = final_name_051926, cluster_broad = broad_category) %>%
                         dplyr::distinct(),
                     by = "cluster")

df_for_tab <- curr_degs_df_trim %>% 
  dplyr::rename(ligand=gene, source_tiss=Tissue, source=cluster, lig_avg_log2FC=meanAcrossAnimals_log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ligand %in% curr_ligands & 
                                                   contrast == curr_lig_contrast & 
                                                   source_tiss == curr_lig_tiss &
                  source %in% curr_lig_sources) %>% 
  ### add broad category (source is already the final name)
    dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                         dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                         dplyr::rename(source = final_name_051926, source_broad = broad_category) %>%
                         dplyr::distinct(),
                     by = "source") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(source_final = source) %>%
  dplyr::select(source_broad,source_final,ligand,lig_avg_log2FC)  %>%
  ### add pairs
  dplyr::left_join(pairs_df, by = "ligand") %>%
  ### add "receptors"
  dplyr::left_join(curr_degs_df_trim %>% 
                     dplyr::rename(receptor=gene, target_tiss=Tissue, target=cluster, rec_avg_log2FC=meanAcrossAnimals_log2FC) %>%
                     dplyr::filter(receptor %in% curr_receptors & 
                                                   contrast == curr_rec_contrast & 
                                                   target_tiss == curr_rec_tiss) %>% 
  ### add broad category (target is already the final name)
    dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                         dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                         dplyr::rename(target = final_name_051926, target_broad = broad_category) %>%
                         dplyr::distinct(),
                     by = "target") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(target_final = target) %>%
  dplyr::select(target_broad,target_final,receptor,rec_avg_log2FC) ,
  by = "receptor") %>%
  ### sort
  dplyr::relocate(source_broad,source_final,ligand,lig_avg_log2FC,target_broad,target_final,receptor,rec_avg_log2FC,pathway) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(pathway),!!!rlang::syms(sort_order))





library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(officer)

# ── 1. Color lookup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
color_lookup <- colors_df_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster_final)) %>%
  select(cluster_final, cluster_broad, color) %>%
  mutate(hex = sapply(color, \(x) rgb(t(col2rgb(x)), maxColorValue = 255)))

get_color_final <- function(name) {
  idx <- match(str_trim(name), color_lookup$cluster_final)
  ifelse(is.na(idx), "#FFFFFF", color_lookup$hex[idx])
}

broad_colors <- color_lookup %>%
  group_by(cluster_broad) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(cluster_broad, hex) %>%
  deframe()

get_color_broad <- function(name) {
  ifelse(is.na(broad_colors[name]), "#FFFFFF", broad_colors[name])
}

# ── 2. Prepare data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_gt <- df_for_tab %>%
  mutate(target_final = str_trim(target_final)) %>%
  select(source_broad, source_final, ligand, lig_avg_log2FC,
         target_broad, target_final, receptor, rec_avg_log2FC, pathway)

# ── 3. Build flextable ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ft <- flextable(df_gt) %>%

  # Column labels
  set_header_labels(
    source_broad   = "Source (broad)",
    source_final   = "Source (final)",
    ligand         = "Ligand",
    lig_avg_log2FC = "Lig log2FC",
    target_broad   = "Target (broad)",
    target_final   = "Target (final)",
    receptor       = "Receptor",
    rec_avg_log2FC = "Rec log2FC",
    pathway        = "Pathway"
  ) %>%

  # ── True vertical merging of duplicate consecutive cells ───────────────────
  merge_v(j = ~ source_broad + source_final + ligand + receptor + pathway) %>%
  merge_v(j = ~ target_broad) %>%

  # ── Helper: build a horizontal bar ggplot with overlaid label ─────────────
  {
    ft_tmp <- .
    lig_max <- max(df_gt$lig_avg_log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)
    rec_max <- max(df_gt$rec_avg_log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)

    contrast_color <- function(hex) {
      rgb <- col2rgb(hex)
      luminance <- (0.299 * rgb[1] + 0.587 * rgb[2] + 0.114 * rgb[3]) / 255
      ifelse(luminance > 0.5, "black", "white")
    }

    make_bar <- function(val, max_val, fill_col) {
      ggplot() +
        geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = val, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
                  fill = fill_col) +
        geom_text(aes(x = 0.02 * max_val, y = 0.5,
                      label = sprintf("%.2f", val)),
                  hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, color = contrast_color(fill_col)) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),   expand = c(0, 0)) +
        theme_void()
    }

    ft_tmp <- mk_par(ft_tmp,
      j = "lig_avg_log2FC",
      value = as_paragraph(
        gg_chunk(
          value  = mapply(make_bar,
                          val      = lig_avg_log2FC,
                          fill_col = sapply(source_final, get_color_final),
                          MoreArgs = list(max_val = lig_max),
                          SIMPLIFY = FALSE),
          width  = 1.2,
          height = 0.2
        )
      )
    )

    ft_tmp <- mk_par(ft_tmp,
      j = "rec_avg_log2FC",
      value = as_paragraph(
        gg_chunk(
          value  = mapply(make_bar,
                          val      = rec_avg_log2FC,
                          fill_col = sapply(target_final, get_color_final),
                          MoreArgs = list(max_val = rec_max),
                          SIMPLIFY = FALSE),
          width  = 1.2,
          height = 0.2
        )
      )
    )
    ft_tmp
  } %>%

  # ── Color source_broad cells ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    ft_tmp <- .
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_gt))) {
      ft_tmp <- bg(ft_tmp, i = i, j = "source_broad",
                   bg = get_color_broad(df_gt$source_broad[i]))
    }
    ft_tmp
  } %>%

  # ── Color source_final cells ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    ft_tmp <- .
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_gt))) {
      ft_tmp <- bg(ft_tmp, i = i, j = "source_final",
                   bg = get_color_final(df_gt$source_final[i]))
    }
    ft_tmp
  } %>%

  # ── Color target_broad cells ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    ft_tmp <- .
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_gt))) {
      ft_tmp <- bg(ft_tmp, i = i, j = "target_broad",
                   bg = get_color_broad(df_gt$target_broad[i]))
    }
    ft_tmp
  } %>%

  # ── Color target_final cells ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    ft_tmp <- .
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_gt))) {
      ft_tmp <- bg(ft_tmp, i = i, j = "target_final",
                   bg = get_color_final(df_gt$target_final[i]))
    }
    ft_tmp
  } %>%

  # ── General styling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  color(part = "header", color = "white") %>%
  bg(part = "header", bg = "gray20") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c("lig_avg_log2FC", "rec_avg_log2FC"), align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all") %>%
  flextable::fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2, part = "body") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed") %>%
  width(j = "source_broad",   width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = "source_final",   width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = "ligand",         width = 0.7) %>%
  width(j = "lig_avg_log2FC", width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = "target_broad",   width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = "target_final",   width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = "receptor",       width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = "rec_avg_log2FC", width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = "pathway",        width = 0.7) %>%

  # Borders
  border_outer(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 2)) %>%
  border_inner_h(part = "body", border = fp_border(color = "gray80", width = 0.5)) %>%
  border_inner_v(part = "all", border = fp_border(color = "gray60", width = 0.5)) %>%

  # Strong vertical line between lig_avg_log2FC and target_broad
  vline(j = "lig_avg_log2FC", border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 2), part = "all") %>%

  # Strong horizontal lines between each pathway block
  {
    ft_tmp <- .
    pathway_breaks <- which(df_gt$pathway != lag(df_gt$pathway, default = ""))
    pathway_breaks <- pathway_breaks[pathway_breaks > 1]
    if (length(pathway_breaks) > 0)
      ft_tmp <- hline(ft_tmp, i = pathway_breaks - 1,
                      border = fp_border(color = "black", width = 2), part = "body")
    ft_tmp
  }

ft

# # ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# # As Word doc (best fidelity for merged cells + bars):
# save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(outputTABLES_dir,paste0(str_remove_all(str_remove_all(name_to_use," "),":"),"_table.docx")))
# 
# # As HTML:
# # save_as_html(ft, path = "table.html")
# 
# # As image (requires webshot2 + magick):
# save_as_image(ft, path = file.path(outputTABLES_dir,paste0(str_remove_all(str_remove_all(name_to_use," "),":"),"_table.png")), res = 150)
#   

     
  list_of_plotted[[paste0(fig_name_to_use)]] <-   df_gt %>% 
  ### add ligand and receptor tiss
  dplyr::mutate(ligand_tiss = paste0(curr_lig_tiss),
                receptor_tiss = paste0(curr_rec_tiss)) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(ligand_tiss, .before = target_broad) %>%
  ### add cellchat yes/no
  dplyr::left_join(net_combo_trim %>%
                     ### add ligand and receptor tiss (same for cellchat)
                     dplyr::mutate(ligand_tiss = ifelse(grepl("PBMC",tiss_dir),"PBMC","LN"),
                                   receptor_tiss = ifelse(grepl("PBMC",tiss_dir),"PBMC","LN"),
                                   ### add cellchat to some columns
                                   cellchat_prob = prob, 
                                   cellchat_pval = pval,
                                   cellchat_interaction_name = interaction_name_2, 
                                   source_final = source,
                                   target_final = target
                                   ) %>%
                     dplyr::select(source_final,ligand,ligand_tiss,target_final, receptor,receptor_tiss, cellchat_prob, cellchat_pval, cellchat_interaction_name),
                   by = c("source_final","ligand","ligand_tiss","target_final", "receptor","receptor_tiss")
                     ) %>%
  
        data.frame() 
      
        
         cat("\n")
      cat(' \n \n') ### this is the key!
```

```{r setFig_BcellSelect}
  # finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Myeloid")],
  finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Bcell")]#,

  # finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "CD8")],

  # finalnames_df$final_name_051926[which(finalnames_df$broad_category == "Prog")]
)

row_variable <- "gene"

degs_to_plot <- c("CD40","TNFRSF13C","CD19","CR2","FCER2","MS4A1",
                  "CD79B","TNFSF9","BCL3","JUNB","TNF","EGR1","CD69","IFI30",
                  "BCL2","BCL2A1","MCL1","BACH2","POU2AF1","ZBTB32","XBP1","SEC11C","CXCR5","CXCR4","GPR183"
                )

## no significance/magnitude filter -- deg_hms already leaves a cell NA
## (white) whenever a gene/cluster/contrast combo isn't in curr_degs_df_trim
## (i.e. not called significant for that cluster), so all 9 genes are shown
## everywhere, with NA where not DEG/not tested.

###### toggle to print/hide numbers in heatmap cells
print_numbers_hm <- TRUE

#### most common DEGs in LN, for reference/QC (not used for filtering)

  dplyr::rename(source=cluster,ligand=gene,source_tiss = Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast %in% contrasts_to_use &
                  source_tiss %in% tiss_to_use_deg) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                     dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(source = final_name_051926, source_broad = broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "source") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(source_final = source) %>%
  dplyr::select(source_final,ligand) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ligand) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(numCelltypes = n()) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(numCelltypes))

### should match names_column_to_use levels (source_final here)
colors_df_final <- colors_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_final = cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(finalnames_df %>%
                     dplyr::select(final_name_051926, broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(cluster = final_name_051926, source_broad = broad_category) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "cluster") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cluster_final))

annotation_colors <- list(
  "cluster"=setNames(colors_df_final$color,
                      colors_df_final$cluster_final),
  "broad"=broad_colors_vec,
  "contrast"=c("DAY2vsPRE"="#5A5399",
               "DAY8vsPRE"="#817ACD",
               "DAY8vsDAY2"="#C1BBFF"),
  "tissue"=c("PBMC"="black","LN"="grey")
)

###### presentation genes, but keep symmetric scale for honesty

scale_low <- -4
scale_high <- 4

breakscale <- c(scale_low, seq(0.9*scale_low, 0.9*scale_high, length.out=length(mycols)-1), 1*scale_high)
```

## 1-vs-Rest Markers {.tabset}

For each tissue separately, conserved across animals, ignoring timepoint/method

Click blue link to download the xlsx with full 1-vs-Rest DEGs for each cluster

```{r printDEGstable, results='asis', eval = TRUE}
#subset_res_to_use <- res_to_use #respt4_rpca_ClustersWithSubs_FINALname
subset_res_to_use <- "respt4_rpca_ClustersWithSubs"
marker_list_name_to_use <- "batch123_38samps_rpca_tiss_trimmed_ann"
#curr_clust_to_keep <- "Bcell"
#"ccrvb47_LIONscRNAseq_batch123_38samps_SubclusteringBroad_RPCA_Bcellonly_reSCT"

test_to_use <- "MAST"
assay_to_use <- "SCT"
minpct_to_use <- 0.1
logfc_to_use <- 0.25



consMarkers_list <- readRDS(file.path(outputRData_dir,paste0(marker_list_name_to_use,
                                                             "_FindConservedMarkers_",
                                                             test_to_use,"_",assay_to_use,
                                                             "_minpct",str_replace(minpct_to_use,"\\.","pt"),
                                                             "_logfc",str_replace(logfc_to_use,"\\.","pt"),
                                                             "_",subset_res_to_use,".rds")))

cluster_tabs <- names(consMarkers_list)[-which(names(consMarkers_list) == "degs_per_cluster_tab")]



### ---- NEW: rename tabs (cluster_Tissue) to FINAL names, then reorder ----
tab_names_old <- names(consMarkers_list)

### split "cluster_Tissue" -> cluster + tissue (tissue = trailing _PBMC or _LN;
### regex anchored at the end so underscores inside cluster names are safe)
is_tiss_tab <- grepl("_(PBMC|LN)$", tab_names_old)
tab_cluster <- ifelse(is_tiss_tab, sub("_(PBMC|LN)$", "", tab_names_old), tab_names_old)
tab_tissue  <- ifelse(is_tiss_tab, sub("^.*_(PBMC|LN)$", "\\1", tab_names_old), NA_character_)

### map original cluster -> FINAL name (name_map built at ~line 1763)
tab_cluster_final <- ifelse(tab_cluster %in% names(name_map),
                            unname(name_map[tab_cluster]),
                            tab_cluster)
tab_names_new <- ifelse(is_tiss_tab, paste0(tab_cluster_final, "_", tab_tissue), tab_names_old)

### sanity checks
unmatched_tabs <- tab_names_old[is_tiss_tab & !(tab_cluster %in% names(name_map))]
if (length(unmatched_tabs) > 0) warning("Tabs with no FINAL name match (kept as-is): ", paste(unmatched_tabs, collapse = ", "))
if (any(nchar(tab_names_new) > 31)) warning("Sheet names >31 chars (Excel limit): ",
                                            paste(tab_names_new[nchar(tab_names_new) > 31], collapse = ", "))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tab_names_new))

consMarkers_list_final <- consMarkers_list
names(consMarkers_list_final) <- tab_names_new

### desired order: degs_per_cluster_tab, then level_order with LN then PBMC adjacent
desired_order <- c("degs_per_cluster_tab",
                   as.vector(rbind(paste0(level_order, "_LN"),
                                   paste0(level_order, "_PBMC"))))
final_tab_order <- c(intersect(desired_order, names(consMarkers_list_final)),
                     setdiff(names(consMarkers_list_final), desired_order))  # leftovers go at the end
consMarkers_list_final <- consMarkers_list_final[final_tab_order]




openxlsx::write.xlsx(consMarkers_list_final,file.path(outputTABLES_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_FindConservedMarkers_",
                                                                                    test_to_use,"_",assay_to_use,
                                                                                    "_minpct",str_replace(minpct_to_use,"\\.","pt"),
                                                                                    "_logfc",str_replace(logfc_to_use,"\\.","pt"),
                                                                                    "_",subset_res_to_use,".xlsx")))

#### add with button
xfun::embed_file(file.path(outputTABLES_dir,paste0(params$study_name,"_FindConservedMarkers_",
                                                                                    test_to_use,"_",assay_to_use,
                                                                                    "_minpct",str_replace(minpct_to_use,"\\.","pt"),
                                                                                    "_logfc",str_replace(logfc_to_use,"\\.","pt"),
                                                                                    "_",subset_res_to_use,".xlsx")), text = "Excel spreadsheet of 1-vs-Rest Markers")



```
